project.title: A Brighter Tomorrow

project.style_block: Realistic 35mm cinematic documentary photography, warm natural Ethiopian highland daylight, authentic Ethiopian rural and modern textures, gentle film grain, shallow depth of field, centered subject composition safe for both 16:9 and 9:16 framing, natural human proportions, respectful realism, no generic stereotypes, no exaggerated costumes, no unrelated cultural motifs, no unreadable text or watermarks in frame.

character.identity_anchor: Fictional Ethiopian male character with warm medium-deep brown skin, expressive dark brown eyes, natural close-cropped curly Ethiopian hair, gentle earnest brow and nose shape, consistent facial bone structure and recognizable identity across all three life stages.

stages.childhood: Approximately 8-10 years old, slim boyish build, rounded youthful cheeks, expressive dark brown eyes, natural close-cropped curly black hair; wearing a clean hand-woven white cotton netela over a simple natural cotton tunic during traditional Qolo Temari study, or a plain everyday shirt during early formal schooling.
stages.adolescence: Approximately 15-17 years old, taller lean Ethiopian high-school student with slightly more defined jawline, same expressive dark brown eyes and natural short curly black hair, wearing a neat collared school shirt under a plain navy knit sweater with a worn backpack.

shots.reason: Establishes a fictionalized Ethiopian highland birthplace-inspired landscape and grounded community atmosphere.
shots.lighting: Soft golden-hour sunrise over misty terraced highland valleys

narration.text: High above the terraced valleys, where morning mist meets stone and earth, every story begins.

shots.lighting: Dappled morning sunlight filtering through shade trees in a quiet stone courtyard
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of the fictional 9-year-old Ethiopian boy (Qolo Temari) wearing a clean white hand-woven cotton netela over a simple natural cotton tunic, seated respectfully on a stone step in the shaded courtyard of a traditional Ethiopian Orthodox stone church compound beneath old trees, attentively reading a traditional parchment brana manuscript resting on his lap (no legible text), with a few quiet fellow students and an elder teacher softly blurred in the courtyard behind, calm dignified atmosphere, centered subject.

narration.text: Long before classrooms or screens, he learned patience and discipline beneath the shade of old trees.

shots.music_cue: Warm acoustic strings hold softly beneath the voice.
shots.cultural_notes: Grounded in documented EOTC Abinet / Nebab Bet practice: Yeqolo Temari student in modest white cotton netela studying Ge'ez reading on brana (parchment) in a shaded church courtyard. Unverified objects or invented rituals are excluded.

shots.reason: Visualizes the physical and emotional transition from traditional learning to formal schooling.

shots.music_cue: Light rhythmic pulse enters gently, evoking forward motion.

shots.reason: Shows formal study of mathematics, science, and languages building his analytical curiosity.
shots.lighting: Soft natural window key light inside a modest wooden classroom

shots.music_cue: Soft piano motif joins the acoustic strings.

shots.reason: Marks the pivotal adolescent encounter with a computer for the first time.
shots.lighting: Warm afternoon room light blended with soft cool glow from a desktop monitor

shots.music_cue: Subtle harmonic lift signaling a turning point.

shots.reason: Depicts active hands-on programming practice as he learns to express logic in code.
shots.lighting: Warm desk lamp rim light balanced with cool screen light

shots.music_cue: Steady light rhythmic momentum builds softly.

shots.reason: Adds emotional authenticity by showing persistence through difficult debugging and late-night study.

shots.reason: Highlights peer collaboration and teamwork among young learners.
